```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using TOML

# --- load every manifest fragment ------------------------------------------
units = Dict{String,Any}[]
for f in sort(readdir("paper_manifest"))
    endswith(f, ".toml") || continue
    for u in get(TOML.parsefile(joinpath("paper_manifest", f)), "unit", Any[])
        push!(units, u)
    end
end

sections = [u for u in units if get(u, "kind", "") == "section"]
const SECTION_ORDER = ["sec-I","sec-II","sec-III","sec-IV","sec-V","app-A","app-B","app-C","app-D"]
secrank(id) = (i = findfirst(==(id), SECTION_ORDER); i === nothing ? 99 : i)

# repo-relative path -> href from docs/
href(p) = "../" * p
field(u, k, d="") = get(u, k, d)

const BADGE = Dict(
    "reproduced"  => ("#1a7f37", "reproduced"),
    "partial"     => ("#bf8700", "partial"),
    "implemented" => ("#0969da", "implemented"),
    "folded"      => ("#6e7781", "folded"),
    "context"     => ("#6e7781", "context"),
    "missing"     => ("#cf222e", "missing"),
    "todo"        => ("#cf222e", "todo"),
)
badge(s) = (c = get(BADGE, s, ("#6e7781", s)); "<span style=\"background:$(c[1]);color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:1px 7px;font-size:.8em;font-weight:600\">$(c[2])</span>")

function links_html(u)
    parts = String[]
    for c in field(u, "code", String[])
        file = split(String(c), ':')[1]
        push!(parts, "<a href=\"$(href(file))\"><code>$(c)</code></a>")
    end
    for t in field(u, "tests", String[])
        push!(parts, "🧪 <code>$(t)</code>")
    end
    r = field(u, "report", ""); isempty(r) || push!(parts, "<a href=\"$(href(r))\">📄 report</a>")
    a = field(u, "anchor", ""); isempty(a) || push!(parts, "<a href=\"$(href(a))\">📖 p.$(field(u,"page",""))</a>")
    isempty(parts) ? "<em>no links yet</em>" : join(parts, " &nbsp;·&nbsp; ")
end

counts(secid) = begin
    ss = [field(u, "status", "todo") for u in units if field(u, "parent", "") == secid]
    Dict(s => count(==(s), ss) for s in unique(ss)), length(ss)
end
nothing
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
# --- headline rollup -------------------------------------------------------
allstatus = [field(u, "status", "todo") for u in units if field(u, "kind", "") != "section"]
tot = length(allstatus)
done = count(s -> s in ("reproduced", "folded", "context"), allstatus)
println("**", tot, " paper units** across ", length(sections), " sections · ",
        badge("reproduced"), " ", count(==("reproduced"), allstatus), " · ",
        badge("partial"), " ", count(==("partial"), allstatus), " · ",
        badge("implemented"), " ", count(==("implemented"), allstatus), " · ",
        badge("folded"), " ", count(==("folded"), allstatus), " · ",
        badge("todo"), " ", count(s -> s in ("todo","missing"), allstatus))
println()
println("\nThe manifest (`docs/paper_manifest/*.toml`) is the single source of truth; ",
        "`check_manifest.jl` verifies every link below resolves. Expand a section, then a unit, ",
        "to trace a physical statement to the paper page and the code that realizes it.\n")

# --- per-section drill-down ------------------------------------------------
for sec in sort(sections, by = s -> secrank(s["id"]))
    cs, n = counts(sec["id"])
    n == 0 && continue   # skip empty sections until they're enriched
    summary = string(cs |> c -> join(["$(v) $(k)" for (k,v) in c], ", "))
    println("<details><summary><strong>", sec["label"], "</strong> &nbsp; ",
            "<span style=\"color:#6e7781\">(", n, " units: ", summary, ")</span></summary>\n")
    for u in sort([u for u in units if field(u, "parent", "") == sec["id"]], by = x -> x["id"])
        println("<div style=\"margin:.5em 0 .3em 1em;padding-left:.8em;border-left:3px solid #d0d7de\">")
        println(badge(field(u, "status", "todo")), " &nbsp; <strong>", field(u, "label"), "</strong> — ",
                field(u, "statement"))
        println("<details style=\"margin:.3em 0 .3em 0\"><summary style=\"font-size:.9em;color:#0969da\">details</summary>")
        println("<div style=\"font-size:.9em;margin:.3em 0 .3em 1em\">")
        m = field(u, "metric", ""); isempty(m) || println("**Result:** ", m, "  \n")
        println("**Links:** ", links_html(u), "  \n")
        nt = field(u, "notes", ""); isempty(nt) || println("**Notes:** ", nt, "  \n")
        println("</div></details>")
        println("</div>")
    end
    println("</details>\n")
end
nothing
```
